q: The highest and the lowest points which show the maximum displacement of vibrating particle from its rest position (or) equilibrium line are called ____ respectively.
e: The crest is the point of maximum positive displacement, while the trough is the point of maximum negative displacement.

q: The distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) two consecutive wave troughs is called ____.
e: Wavelength is the spatial period of the wave, measured between two consecutive points in the same phase.

q: The unit of wavelength in SI unit is ____.
e: As a measure of distance, the standard SI unit for wavelength is the metre.

q: Generally the wavelength is the distance between two nearest points of ____.
e: Points in the same phase have identical displacement and velocity at any given instant.

q: The number of complete waves passing a point per second of a vibrating source is also called ____.
e: Frequency measures how often the wave cycle repeats per unit of time.

q: The SI unit of frequency is ____.
e: One hertz is defined as one complete wave cycle per second.
This is the fundamental definition of the hertz unit in wave mechanics.

q: The time taken by the wave to travel the distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) the time required for one complete vibration is called ____ of a wave.
e: The period is the temporal duration of one full wave cycle.

q: The unit of period is the ____.
e: Time intervals in wave motion, such as the period, are measured in seconds in the SI system.

q: The period is the ____ of the frequency.
e: Mathematically, the period $T$ and frequency $f$ are related by the equation $T = 1/f$.

q: The amplitude of a wave is the ____ of displacement of vibrating particle.
e: Amplitude represents the greatest distance a particle moves from its equilibrium position.

q: Velocity of wave is the ____ with which a wave crest travels.
e: Wave velocity describes how fast the wave profile propagates through the medium.

q: The unit of wave velocity is ____.
e: As a measure of speed, wave velocity is expressed in metres per second in the SI system.

q: Most of the periodic waves are represented by ____ graphs.
e: Periodic wave motion is mathematically modeled using sinusoidal functions.

q: The relationship between the frequency, wavelength and velocity of a periodic wave can be obtained by ____.
e: This fundamental wave equation states that wave velocity equals the product of frequency and wavelength.
